text: 1、市场全天低开低走，三大指数集体下挫。煤炭板块逆势走强，宝泰隆、陕西黑猫、大有能源、美锦能源涨停。航运板块盘中异动，南京港涨停。银行板块拉升，江苏银行股价创新高，中信银行涨超4%。下跌方面，机器人概念股大幅调整，锋龙股份、中大力德、正裕工业等多股跌停；算力硬件股走低，长飞光纤、可川科技、永鼎股份等跌停。个股呈现普跌态势，沪深京三市超5000股飘绿，今日成交2.53万亿。截止收盘沪指跌2.4%，深成指跌5.01%，创业板指跌6.26%。 2、板块概念方面，煤炭、银行、港口航运等板块逆势走强，算力硬件、半导体芯片、机器人等板块跌幅居前。 3、两市共421只
text_en: 1. Markets opened low and fell throughout the day, with all three major indices declining. Coal stocks rose against the trend, with Baotailong, Shaanxi Heimao, Dayou Energy, and Meijin Energy hitting limit-up. Shipping stocks moved higher midday, with Nanjing Port hitting limit-up. Banking stocks rallied, with Jiangsu Bank hitting a record high and China CITIC Bank up over 4%. On the downside, robotics concept stocks fell sharply, with Fenglong Shares, Zhongda Leader, and Zhengyu Industrial among those hitting limit-down; computing hardware stocks declined, with YOFC, Kechuan Technology, and Yongding Shares hitting limit-down. Stocks broadly fell, with over 5,000 declining across Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing, on 2.53 trillion yuan in turnover. At close, the Shanghai Composite fell 2.4%, the Shenzhen Component fell 5.01%, and the ChiNext fell 6.26%. 2. By sector, coal, banking, and port/shipping outperformed, while computing hardware, semiconductors, and robotics led declines. 3. A total of 421 stocks...
